subject.title: Add Claw status and remove lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw accept `claws status` and `claws remove` as the first core Claws lifecycle-management contract, including persisted SQLite refs, warning-only plugin provenance, dry-run/yes removal, hash-revalidated workspace deletion, and partial-cleanup behavior?
rationale: The implementation is reviewable and no concrete patch defect was found, but this creates a new core CLI/state lifecycle and file-deletion behavior that automation cannot approve as product direction or upgrade policy.

options.title: Approve Stacked Lifecycle Contract
options.body: Keep this PR open and review it after the prerequisite Claws PRs/RFC settle, then merge if maintainers accept the command, JSON, state, and removal semantics.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Ask the author to reduce or reshape status/remove behavior if maintainers want less core lifecycle surface or different cleanup semantics before accepting Claws.

options.title: Pause The Lifecycle Slice
options.body: Leave this draft parked or close it later if Claws lifecycle management should move to a different ClawHub/plugin-owned design instead of core.

recommendation.title: Approve Stacked Lifecycle Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and review it after the prerequisite Claws PRs/RFC settle, then merge if maintainers accept the command, JSON, state, and removal semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision combines Claws product direction with plugin lifecycle, trusted artifact provenance, and file-removal safety, matching the strongest adjacent plugin lifecycle history among likely owners.
